{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the number of missing values in flipper_length_mm
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Check if the missing flipper_length_mm values are related to species
missing_flipper_by_species = df[df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]['species'].value_counts()
print("Species with missing flipper_length_mm:")
print(missing_flipper_by_species)"}
